_metadata.description: Golden-fixture registry for AI prompt templates (ST-09, BLG-AI-07, EPIC-03, v9.8). Each entry pins the exact template text (via sha256) to the prompt_version recorded in the source at fixture-authoring time. tests/test_ai_prompt_template_golden_fixtures.py fails a covered template's drift check if its text changes without prompt_version also changing. When intentionally editing a covered template: bump the source's prompt_version/PROMPT_VERSION constant AND update this fixture's sha256 + prompt_version for that entry in the same commit.
